name: box-local-engine
description: Standalone local-first voxel engine developer preview

scripts.creator: node apps/local-engine/src/deploy.js creator
scripts.license-server:build: docker compose --env-file apps/license-server/.env -f apps/license-server/docker-compose.yml build license-server
scripts.license-server:logs: docker compose --env-file apps/license-server/.env -f apps/license-server/docker-compose.yml logs -f license-server
scripts.infra: docker compose --profile infra up -d postgres redis
scripts.infra:stop: docker compose --profile infra stop postgres redis
scripts.build:creator: node apps/local-engine/src/build.js --creator
scripts.start:creator: node apps/local-engine/src/launcher.js --production --creator
scripts.check: pnpm check:local-control && pnpm check:engine && pnpm check:distribution && pnpm check:integration
scripts.check:local-control: node apps/local-engine/src/build-metadata.test.js && node apps/local-engine/scripts/regression-project-storage-identity.js && node scripts/regression-empty-mesh-asset.js && node scripts/check-standalone.js && node scripts/check-play-version-refresh.js
scripts.check:engine: pnpm --filter @box-local/game run test:local-runtime-session && pnpm --filter @box-local/voxa run check:model-library-scope && pnpm --filter @box-local/voxa run check:model-project-bundle && pnpm --filter @box-local/voxa run check:local-cors && pnpm --filter @box-local/game-server run check:disabled-storage && node scripts/platform-api-removal.test.js && node scripts/check-engine-wire-protocols.js
scripts.check:distribution: pnpm check:license && node scripts/check-windows-offline-installer.js && node --test scripts/build-desktop-offline-installer.test.js scripts/verify-desktop-offline-package.test.js && node scripts/check-desktop-deployment-manager.js && node scripts/check-release-workflow.js && node scripts/check-documentation.js
scripts.check:integration: pnpm --filter @box-local/game-server exec node -r @swc-node/register scripts/regression-map-group-state-lock.ts && pnpm --dir examples/player-auth-portal check && pnpm --filter @box-local/server-manager test && pnpm --filter @box-local/migrator test && node --test scripts/teleport-room-manager.test.js scripts/teleport-library-integration.test.js
scripts.check:license: pnpm --filter @box-local/license test && pnpm --filter @box-local/license-server test && node scripts/check-license-boundaries.js
scripts.lint: pnpm lint:control && pnpm --filter @box-local/game lint && pnpm --filter @box-local/voxa lint && pnpm --filter @box-local/migrator lint
scripts.lint:control: eslint apps/local-engine/src apps/local-engine/scripts apps/server-manager apps/license-server packages/license scripts --ext .js,.cjs
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @box-local/local-engine test && pnpm --filter @box-local/game-server test && pnpm check
scripts.verify: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
